reason: Thirty-six dollars for a tinted lip balm is a lot on my budget, and I already have a drawer full of lipsticks I wore once. Even two for $59 isn't the kind of deal I wait for, and with no reviews it looks like every other color-changing ad I scroll past.
objection: Paying $36 up front for a brand-new product nobody has reviewed yet, when the year-long guarantee still means I have to chase a refund if it dries my lips like the rest.
would_change_my_mind: A real price drop or buy-one-get-one under $25, plus reviews from women my age saying it actually doesn't dry out or bleed.
